why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Looping Collective app Go to the Looping Collective app . It lists loopedHYPE (LHYPE) among its products.
2 Step 2 : Deposit into loopedHYPE Open the loopedHYPE product page and deposit staked HYPE, kHYPE or HYPE. You receive LHYPE as a receipt token.
3 Step 3 : Stake LOOP for multipliers Use the points page to stake LOOP. The app invites a deposit of 5,000 LOOP for weekly Loyalty Rewards, and staking adds multipliers to your loopedHYPE rewards.
4 Step 4 : Check your LoopDrop allocation Open the LoopDrops checker to view your HyperLend points breakdown and allocation.
5 Step 5 : Read the airdrop phases in the docs The docs describe the Early Adopter, Loyalty and LoopDrops phases that LOOP staking multiplies.
